description: Replaces personal data in a text with placeholders: e-mail addresses, phone numbers, IBANs (mod 97 checked), payment card numbers (Luhn checked only), IPv4 addresses and, with names true, person names found by the chat model. Returns the redacted text and counts per type. Original values are never returned. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

names.description: true to also replace person names (uses the chat model)

types.description: Any of email, phone, iban, card, ip (default all)

name: redact
